title: e <= 3, via a genuine {0, 1, k+2} case split at the mathematical kink
statement: le e three, three := add two one -- the classical index-2 split sharpening e <= 4: e = sum 1/n! = 1 + 1 + sum_{n>=2} 1/n!, the first two terms exact, and for n >= 2, 1/n! <= (1/2)^(n-1) so the tail is at most sum_{k>=1} (1/2)^k = 1. Built WITHOUT any new Nat-level factorial fact, via the pure CReal-algebra identity 2 * pow half (succ m) ~ pow half m. UNLIKE e_le_four, this is NOT one uniform forall-n bound but a nested Nat.rec on {0, 1, k+2}: expSeriesPartial 0 = expSeriesPartial 1 = 1, not yet geometric, so the index-2 kink is mathematical, not an artifact of the formalization.

formal.statement: theorem CReal.e_le_three : CReal.le CReal.e (CReal.add (CReal.ofRat (Rat.normalize (Int.ofNat (AxNat.succ (AxNat.succ AxNat.zero))) (AxNat.succ AxNat.zero) (AxNat.le.refl (AxNat.succ AxNat.zero)))) CReal.one)
